rows.name: Alabama
rows.authority: Alabama Secretary of State (Alabama Votes election-night site, www2.alabamavotes.gov)
rows.notes: Page is SOS-branded ('Alabama Votes | Alabama Secretary of State') and currently reads 'Results Coming Soon. Polls close at 7:00 p.m. CST.' The URL without ecode serves the same page and its own links use ecode=1001290, but I could not confirm that code is the Nov 3 general (a web-search lead associated it with the May primary), so treated as landing/pending. I did not find this host linked from sos.alabama.gov pages I fetched; www.alabamavotes.gov redirects to sos.alabama.gov. Fallback SOS data page (linked from SOS, no general results yet): https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes/voter/election-data (200 at 2026-11-02T23:39:02Z).

rows.name: Alaska
rows.notes: Page has a '2026 General Election – November 3, 2026' section, 'Results Status: Unofficial', last updated Oct 31, 2026 (zero-totals report); state posts results after 9 p.m. AKST on election night.

rows.name: Arizona
rows.authority: Arizona Secretary of State (results hosted by Enhanced Voting)
rows.notes: Link text on azsos.gov 2026 Election Info page: 'Unofficial 2026 General Election Results' (https://azsos.gov/elections/election-information/2026-election-info). Results not posted yet (election is Nov 3). SOS ENR landing https://azsos.gov/elections/election-information/unofficial-enr is 403 to curl (opened via browser pane).

rows.name: Arkansas
rows.notes: Linked from https://www.sos.arkansas.gov/elections/research/election-results as '2012-2026 Election Results' (link goes through a linkprotect wrapper to arkansas.tally-enr.com). That SOS page lists 2026 elections only through the primaries/specials; no Nov 3 general election entry yet, so landing/pending.

rows.name: California
rows.authority: California Secretary of State (election results site)
rows.notes: curl gets HTTP 200 but the body is a 212-byte Imperva/Incapsula JS-challenge stub, and the browser pane refused the host, so the page content could not be inspected; host is a sos.ca.gov subdomain. I did not find it linked from the SOS general-election pages fetched. Verified fallback (SOS archive; lists 2026 primary, no Nov 3 general yet): https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/prior-elections/statewide-election-results (200 at 2026-11-02T23:39:08Z).

rows.name: Colorado
rows.authority: Colorado Secretary of State (statewide Election Night Reporting on Clarity)
rows.notes: URL taken from the Colorado SOS press release dated 2026-11-02 ('Election Night Reporting (ENR) System' link) at https://coloradosos.gov/pubs/newsRoom/pressReleases/2026/PR20261102ElectionResults.html. The release says the ENR link will also be posted on the SOS home page and GoVoteColorado.gov on election night; the Clarity page is a JS app so its content was not inspected. SOS county-status map: https://www.coloradosos.gov/pubs/elections/Results/ENR/countyMapStatuses.html.

rows.name: Connecticut
rows.notes: SOTS Election Results page; it links the 'Elections Management System (Electronic Election Results - August 2018 to Present)' at https://ctemspublic.pcctg.net/#/selectTown, which is where electronic results are published. That EMS URL returns 200 but redirects to https://ctemspublic.tgstg.net/ (checked 2026-11-02T23:39:04Z) and I could not confirm it shows the Nov 3 general; so the stable SOTS page is recorded as primary. Historic archive: https://electionhistory.ct.gov/eng/.

rows.name: Delaware
rows.notes: Page header '2026 General Election, November 3, 2026, Unofficial Results' with a results-reporting status section; linked from the Department of Elections home page. Results not in yet.

rows.name: District of Columbia
rows.authority: District of Columbia Board of Elections
rows.notes: Linked from https://dcboe.org/elections/2026-elections. Page is a JS app ('DCBOE Election Results'); content for the Nov 3 general could not be confirmed from the static response, so recorded as landing/pending.

rows.name: Florida
rows.authority: Florida Department of State, Division of Elections
rows.notes: Linked from the DOS Election Results Archive page (https://dos.fl.gov/elections/data-statistics/elections-data/election-results-archive/). The page is a frames page ('Florida Department of State - Election Results'); Nov 3 general contest data not confirmed.

rows.name: Georgia
rows.notes: Enhanced Voting single-page app at the SOS results subdomain. It returns HTTP 200 for any election path, so a 2026-general-specific URL cannot be verified by curl; the landing page is recorded. sos.ga.gov/page/georgia-election-results (the SOS results page linked from georgia.gov's 2026 general-election page) returned 403 to curl, so the link chain from sos.ga.gov to results.sos.ga.gov was not confirmed.

rows.name: Hawaii
rows.notes: Results landing page already has a 'General Election, November 3, 2026' block (Statewide Summary, county summaries, Statement of Vote, text files) but every link points to a /wp-content/results/Placeholders/ file, so actual results are not posted yet.

rows.name: Idaho
rows.notes: Landing page's 2026 section covers only the May 19 Primary (county results at results.voteidaho.gov .../elections/may2026); no November 2026 general results or link yet.

rows.name: Illinois
rows.notes: Official vote totals page; the latest election listed is '2026 GENERAL PRIMARY' (no 2026 general yet). ISBE's ElectionResults.aspx states that unofficial local results are not reported to the State Board or posted on its website; unofficial election-night results are on each local election authority's site (contact list at ElectionAuthorities.aspx).

rows.name: Indiana
rows.authority: Indiana Secretary of State / Election Division (Indiana Voter Portal election night reporting)
rows.notes: Election-night reporting site linked as 'View all results' from indianavoters.in.gov. It is a JavaScript app: the HTML says 'Complete unofficial results may not be available election night; please check back' and shows unfilled template placeholders, so no specific election is selected yet.

rows.name: Iowa
rows.notes: Redirects to /IA/ (the ':443' is as reported by curl) and shows a 'List Elections' single-page app; the 2026 general is not selectable via curl. The host is on the state iowa.gov domain, but sos.iowa.gov returned 403 to curl so a link from the SOS site to this host was not confirmed.

rows.name: Kansas
rows.notes: Official results landing page lists 2026 Primary results only. A Kansas SOS press release (sos.ks.gov, 11-05-24) says the unofficial election-night reporting page goes live on the SOS website at 5 p.m. on election day and official results are posted on this page after the State Board of Canvassers certifies.

rows.name: Kentucky
rows.notes: SBE results landing; latest entry is '2026 Primary Recap Sheets'. The SBE home page also shows a '2026 General Election Night Reporting Results' link to https://vrsws.sos.ky.gov/liveresults, which returned 403 (SBE 'Acceptable Use Policy' bot block) to both curl and WebFetch, so it could not be opened and is not recorded as the results URL.

rows.name: Louisiana
rows.authority: Louisiana Secretary of State (live Graphical election results)
rows.notes: SOS live-results portal (JavaScript app; election is chosen in-page). The 'Graphical election results' link on sos.la.gov/elections-voting/election-results-statistics is a template link containing the literal '--environment--' host (voterportal.--environment--.sos.la.gov/graphical); the production host voterportal.sos.la.gov was used and returns 200.

rows.name: Maine
rows.notes: Election Results/Data page; its 2026 section covers the June 9 primary and the 2026 special elections only, no November general results yet.

rows.name: Maryland
rows.notes: Linked from the board's 2026 elections index as 'Unofficial General Results'. Page titled 'Unofficial 2026 Gubernatorial General Election Results'; the contest links are in place but no results are posted yet (election not held). A first parallel curl attempt hit a connection reset; the retry returned 200.

rows.name: Massachusetts
rows.authority: Massachusetts Secretary of the Commonwealth, Elections Division (PD43+ Election Statistics)
rows.notes: Official Massachusetts results database, linked from the Elections Division. The election-date list currently tops out at Sep 1, 2026 and has no Nov 3, 2026 entry yet. Earlier parallel curl attempts timed out or reset; this retry returned 200.

rows.name: Michigan
rows.authority: Michigan Department of State (Secretary of State), Bureau of Elections
rows.notes: State results hub. The state's actual results database is MVIC at https://mvic.sos.state.mi.us/votehistory/Index?type=C (curl returned 200 on this form, 403 on the form with &electionDate=11-3-2026). I opened the dated form in the browser pane: its election-date list stops at 8/4/2026 State Primary and says 'No election results for selected election date' for 11/3/2026. The old mielections.us results domain does not connect. County sites carry election-night unofficial results.

rows.name: Minnesota
rows.notes: curl is redirected to a Radware captcha interstitial (validate.perfdrive.com, 200); the requested URL is published. In the browser pane https://electionresults.sos.mn.gov/ loaded normally and showed the August 11, 2026 State Primary; no Nov 3, 2026 general page yet.

rows.name: Mississippi
rows.notes: Election Results archive; latest 2026 entries are the March 10, 2026 primaries, with no 2026 general entry yet. Earlier parallel curl attempts hit connection resets; the retry returned 200.

rows.name: Missouri
rows.notes: Election Night Reporting section says it shows the most recent or current election; it currently lists the Aug 4, 2026 primary first and has no Nov 3, 2026 general entry. enr.sos.mo.gov returns a 307 redirect to this page. Earlier parallel curl attempts reset; the retry returned 200.

rows.name: Montana
rows.notes: 403 to curl (Cloudflare challenge on sosmt.gov after the redirect). In the browser pane the redirect lands on 'Official Election Results' (sosmt.gov/elections/results/), which links the 2026 Primary results at electionresults.mt.gov; no 2026 general page yet. Earlier curl attempts to electionresults.mt.gov failed to connect or reset.

rows.name: Nebraska
rows.notes: Page header reads 'Unofficial Results General Election November 3, 2026'; counts are all zero as of 'Results last updated: 10/29/2026'. Linked from sos.nebraska.gov/elections.

rows.name: Nevada
rows.authority: Nevada Secretary of State (Results.NV.gov / Silver State Election Night Results)
rows.notes: curl failed: first run curl exit 47 (more than 50 redirects, last status 302); later runs got a 302 then 'curl (35) connection reset', and a cookie-jar run got 403. This is an Incapsula bot challenge. In the browser pane the page loads as '2026 General Overview', 'Auto-refreshing unofficial', last updated Oct 28 2026, all races 'awaiting results'. The state's 2026 election information page links to it as Results.NV.gov.

rows.name: New Hampshire
rows.notes: 403 to curl (bot protection on sos.nh.gov); the page opens in a real browser (browser pane) and is titled '2026 General Election Results'. It says 'Election results will be linked on this page upon completion following the Election.' and lists the contest/county placeholders. Reached via sos.nh.gov/2026-election-results, linked from sos.nh.gov/elections.

rows.name: New Jersey
rows.authority: New Jersey Department of State, Division of Elections
rows.notes: Page is titled 2026 Election Night Results. It states: 'The Division of Elections does not post any official or unofficial results on Election Night. The best source for election night results are the local county websites linked below.' It then lists each county's results site. Statewide certified results are published later by the Division (nj.gov/state/elections/election-results.shtml, also 200).

rows.name: New Mexico
rows.notes: Linked from the sos.nm.gov home page. Page header reads 'Unofficial Results GENERAL 2026 November 3, 2026', 'Results last updated: 11/2/2026 3:35 PM MT', 0 ballots cast so far (pre-election shell).

rows.name: New York
rows.authority: New York State Board of Elections
rows.notes: State BOE results landing page; it currently offers the certified 2026 Primary results ('Download the Certified Results from the 2026 Primary Election') and no 2026 general page yet. The linked results.elections.ny.gov (200) is the state's historical Voting & Elections Database ('A searchable database of historical election information'); I could not confirm it carries a 2026 general election-night feed.

rows.name: North Carolina
rows.authority: North Carolina State Board of Elections
rows.notes: Election Results Dashboard (the State Board's results portal). The NCSBE Reporter's Primer (2026-10-27) says unofficial results will be reported on it election night. It is a multi-election dashboard whose election dropdown loaded empty for me, so I could not confirm a 2026-general selection; treated as landing.

rows.name: North Dakota
rows.notes: Linked from sos.nd.gov/elections/election-results as 'General Election Results - November 3, 2026'. Page renders 'NORTH DAKOTA ELECTION NIGHT REPORTING 2026 General Election, Tuesday 03 Nov 2026'. The SOS media guide says unofficial results start appearing at 8 p.m. CST on Election Day. The older results.sos.nd.gov host still defaults to the 2024 general and is not used.

rows.name: Ohio
rows.notes: Ohio Decides - Election Night Reporting. The SOS Week in Review (2026-10-30) says election-night results 'will be available on LiveResults.OhioSoS.gov'. The shell page names no election and shows no contests yet. ohiosos.gov pages return 403 to curl; the liveresults host returned 200.

rows.name: Oklahoma
rows.notes: The Board's 2026 Election Results page lists 'November 3 General Elections' with no link yet (earlier 2026 elections are linked). The Board's Oct 2026 release says results will be on its website after polls close at 7 p.m. The results.okelections.gov host returned 403 to curl and was not confirmed, so it is not used.

rows.name: Oregon
rows.notes: Page header reads 'Unofficial General Election November 3, 2026', results last updated 10/30/2026 3:30 PM PT, 0 ballots counted. The SOS page says 'Unofficial results will be available at results.oregonvotes.gov shortly after 8 p.m. on November 3'.

rows.name: Pennsylvania
rows.notes: Page header reads 'Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 2026 General Election (Unofficial Returns)'. It is currently in TESTING MODE: 'Data displayed is for testing purposes only. Live data from counties will appear after polls close at 8 p.m. Nov. 3, 2026.' The DOS release 'Important Information Ahead of Tomorrow's General Election' names it as 'the Department of State's election night returns site'.

rows.name: Rhode Island
rows.notes: Linked from elections.ri.gov/elections/results as 'November 3, 2026 General Election Results'. Page renders 'Rhode Island Statewide General Election November 3, 2026, UNOFFICIAL RESULTS', last updated Fri Oct 30 2026 11:55 AM, zero votes so far. Client-rendered page; curl sees only a shell.

rows.name: South Carolina
rows.notes: State results landing page; its 2026 list (latest entry Sept 1, 2026 State Senate 15 special primary) has no Nov 3, 2026 general link yet. Vendor ENR root https://www.enr-scvotes.org/SC/ returned 200 but is a JS list; no Nov 3 election to link to yet.

rows.name: South Dakota
rows.notes: Page header reads 'Unofficial Results General Election November 3, 2026'; linked from the SOS voting page as 'General Election Results'. No results yet (0 precincts reporting; last updated 10/30/2026 5:41 PM CT).

rows.name: Tennessee
rows.notes: Election Night Reporting Dashboard (redirects to /categories/governor/offices); page nav reads 'November 3, 2026 Election'. This host is the one the TN SOS Aug 6 press release names for election-night results. No results yet.

rows.name: Texas
rows.authority: Texas Secretary of State (Election Night Returns, Civix ENR)
rows.notes: Linked as 'Election Night Returns' in the Nov 3, 2026 Election Notice banner on sos.state.tx.us. It is a JS single-page app, so curl cannot confirm which election it shows; treated as landing until polls close.

rows.notes: Official results site (redirects to /results/public/Utah). vote.utah.gov home page currently links only the June 23, 2026 primary results page, no Nov 3 general link yet. The site is a JS app that returns 200 for any election slug, so a Nov 3 page could not be confirmed.

rows.name: Vermont
rows.notes: 'Vermont Election Night Results' portal linked from sos.vermont.gov/elections. JS single-page app; could not confirm a Nov 3 specific page from curl.

rows.name: Virginia
rows.notes: Linked from https://www.elections.virginia.gov/results/ under 'Unofficial Results: November 3, 2026 General and Special Elections'. ENR is a JS app; no results yet.

rows.name: West Virginia
rows.authority: West Virginia Secretary of State (Clarity ENR)
rows.notes: Button labelled '2026 General Election Results' on https://sos.wv.gov/govotewv. Clarity ENR is a JS app; no results yet.

rows.name: Wisconsin
rows.notes: WEC says Wisconsin has no statewide unofficial election-night reporting site; unofficial numbers come from the 72 county clerks, and WEC posts official results after canvass (latest entry 2026 Partisan Primary). Landing page recorded; pending until canvass. Plain curl returned 403 (Cloudflare bot protection); the page opens (200) when curl sends browser Accept headers.

rows.name: Wyoming
